literal: The means, and the time, and the manner of execution, and the difficult task to be performed, that which is excellent in these is the minister.
translation: An excellent minister is one who excels in choosing the right means, the right time, the proper manner of execution, and the difficult task to be performed.
modern: தேவையான கருவி, ஏற்ற காலம், செய்யும் முறை, செய்ய வேண்டிய அரிய செயல் ஆகியவற்றைச் சிறந்த முறையில் தேர்ந்தெடுப்பதே அமைச்சின் தன்மையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core responsibilities and qualities of a minister or ministry. A successful minister must possess excellence in four distinct areas: identifying the proper resources or instruments (karuvi), choosing the opportune moment (kālam), determining the correct method of execution (ceykai), and selecting the rare or difficult task (aruvinai) that needs to be accomplished. The word 'māṇṭatu' emphasizes that the ministry must be outstanding and glorious in managing these four elements. Thus, effective statecraft is presented as a masterful coordination of resources, timing, execution, and strategic goals.
